text: Found it: in middleware/proxy.go the balancers panic when they have no targets (randomBalancer.Next does Intn(0)/out-of-range index, roundRobinBalancer.Next does % 0), so the proxy middleware crashes instead of failing gracefully. Fixing it so Next returns nil for an empty target list and ProxyWithConfig returns 503 (echo.ErrServiceUnavailable). ETA ~5 min.
On it: a subagent is investigating router.go for the no-routable-path case (likely a panic/hang or wrong result when no route matches) and will fix it minimally. ETA ~12 min.

Fixed and verified. In middleware/proxy.go: randomBalancer.Next and roundRobinBalancer.Next now return nil when the target list is empty (no more Intn(0)/out-of-range panic or integer divide by zero), and ProxyWithConfig returns echo.ErrServiceUnavailable (503) when the balancer yields no target. A temporary test reproducing the no-targets case passed for both balancers (and panicked before the fix); it was removed afterwards. gofmt clean, full `go test ./...` green (echo + middleware), no pre-existing test regressed.

Still in progress: a subagent is working out the no-routable-path bug in router.go (panic/hang or wrong result when no route matches) and fixing it minimally, then re-running the full test suite. ETA ~8 min.

On it: a subagent is fixing context.go's Scheme() so invalid X-Forwarded-Proto / X-Forwarded-Protocol values are ignored (falling back to http, or https on TLS) instead of being returned raw. ETA ~10 min.
On it: a subagent is fixing bind.go's bindDataToMap so binding into a map[string][]string destination works correctly (all values for repeated keys). ETA ~10 min.

Fixed and verified. context.go's Scheme() now only honours valid forwarded scheme values: an invalid X-Forwarded-Proto is ignored so X-Forwarded-Protocol is used next, and if all forwarded headers are invalid it falls back to "http" ("https" on TLS). Values are trimmed/lowercased, so "HTTPS" and " https " work. A temporary test covering all three scenarios passed; it was removed afterwards. gofmt/vet clean, all real repo tests still green (no pre-existing test regressed).
Fixed and verified (proxy.go): empty balancers now return nil from Next instead of panicking, and ProxyWithConfig returns 503 (echo.ErrServiceUnavailable).
Still in progress: the router.go no-routable-path fix is being worked on (the subagent is chasing a wrong-result/panic case when no route matches). ETA ~6 min.
Fixed and verified (context.go): Scheme() now ignores invalid X-Forwarded-Proto / X-Forwarded-Protocol / X-Url-Scheme values, uses the next valid source, and falls back to "http" (or "https" on TLS).
Still in progress: a subagent is fixing bind.go's bindDataToMap for map[string][]string destinations. ETA ~8 min.
On it: a subagent is fixing group.go so that two groups registering the same path with different middleware don't leak middleware into each other's routes. ETA ~12 min.
On it: a subagent is fixing middleware/compress.go's handling of an empty response body (gzip stream / headers consistency). ETA ~12 min.
Fixed and verified (proxy.go): empty balancer no longer panics; ProxyWithConfig returns 503.
Still in progress: the router.go no-routable-path fix is being worked on; the subagent is verifying the fix against the full suite. ETA ~8 min.
Fixed and verified (context.go): Scheme() ignores invalid forwarded scheme headers and falls back to http/https.
Still in progress: bind.go's bindDataToMap fix for map[string][]string is being verified. ETA ~6 min.
Still in progress: the group.go same-path/different-middleware fix is being verified. ETA ~8 min.
Still in progress: the compress.go empty-body (gzip) fix is being verified. ETA ~10 min.
